title: Winter Basin Snow Days party (Cuenca Invernal)
names_seen: Winter Basin Snow Days party (Cuenca Invernal)

facts.statement: The Snow Days season's first community party was held at the Winter Basin fishing area, an icy lake that is the Snow Days starting point, on Server 1.
facts.quote: es la primera fiesta de la temporada de Días de Nieve

facts.statement: The Americas session was scheduled for Thursday 9 December 2010 at 15:00 Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Jueves 9 de Diciembre del 2010 15:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was scheduled for Friday 10 December 2010 at 09:00 Pacific Time, which is 16:00 GMT, on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 10 de Diciembre del 2010 09:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 hrs. GMT (Reino Unido y Europa) Servidor 1

facts.statement: Players were encouraged to wear winter outfits and seasonal costumes and bring a boombox to the party, and to bring mittens.
facts.quote: Viste los atuendos invernales, luce los disfraces de la temporada y trae tu radio casetera

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Temporada Cuenca Invernal
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice for the Winter Basin (Cuenca Invernal) Snow Days party, a fishing-area celebration held on Server 1 on two dates in December 2010, with the Pacific and GMT start times listed per region. The page gives the event schedule and attire suggestions (winter outfits, seasonal costumes, a boombox) but no rewards or mechanics. The posting date is only given as a relative age, so the exact publication date is unknown.
